remarks: Beautifully upgraded La Jolla model--the largest floorplan in Leisure Village--with a spacious room addition off the primary bedroom bringing the home to over 2,000 sq. ft. of living space. This impressive home offers a wonderful combination of space, comfort and thoughtful updates throughout. The inviting living room features a fireplace, wood flooring, crown molding and recessed lighting, while skylights bring in additional natural light. Elegant touches include rounded archways, updated interior doors, plantation shutters and a beautiful stained-glass front door. The kitchen features warm maple cabinetry and a newer dishwasher.
